summary: Nora can hold one synthesized portrait of a room's own character, built from what she already knows about its words and its people.
details: Plan 3 of the Dreamer: a single narrative per room, synthesized from Plan 1's vocabulary and Plan 2's exchange patterns — the room's own character as a whole, never a claim about any one person in it.
No new model call: the synthesis is a deterministic template over the SAME already-vetted material she already sees in the room's own two other blocks, never more.
The narrative-building step cannot see who said or was involved in anything — participant and speaker identity is stripped before the sentence is built, not merely left unused.
Triggered by real new material appearing (the room's vocabulary or exchange patterns actually changed), not by a raw-message timer — a quiet room does not get resynthesized for nothing.
limitations: Ships turned off, gated by the same switch as the room-language glossary and exchange patterns. It is not live in any room yet.
Stacked on Plan 2 (unmerged) — depends on the exchange-pattern consolidator landing first.
